'''Carmelle''' was a small settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]]. Located approximately twenty [[Meter/Legends|kilometers]] from the [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Shulell City]], Carmelle served as the [[dingory]] meat processing center for several ranches in the area. The settlement maintained stockyards and slaughter houses, and was visited often by ranchers and their herds.
